name: Exiles
source:
Exiles, is a fantasy adventure taking you from a 1001 Arabian Nights style land to far colder climes across the ocean to the other side of the planet as the fate of the world hangs in the balance! You grew up a penniless orphan on the streets of Dumat al-Julfar, never expecting what fate had in store for you. Taken into the service of a rich patron, you'll rise from lowly servant to epic (at least somewhat) hero! 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/timepants]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Exiles》是一场奇幻冒险。世界的命运危在旦夕，你将从一片充满《一千零一夜》风情的土地出发，跨越海洋，前往星球另一端更加寒冷的地域！你是个身无分文的孤儿，在杜马特·朱尔法的街头长大，从未想到命运会为自己安排怎样的人生。受一位富有的恩主雇用后，你将从卑微的仆人，成长为史诗般的英雄——至少，也算有点英雄的样子吧！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/timepants]Patreon[/url]]
